claims.text: Upbit announced RSR KRW and USDT markets at 13:54 KST (04:54 UTC) on 12 October 2026 with trading from 14:05 KST.
RSR rose about 46-47% in 24 hours on Binance; spot high $0.002999, $0.00236 at 08:48 UTC.
Binance RSR perpetual funding settled at -1.96% at 08:00 UTC against a -2% floor; OKX settled at its -1% floor.
Binance RSR open interest rose about 4.4x in coins between 00:00 and 08:48 UTC (our arithmetic).
Upbit KRW-RSR peaked at 4.98 won, about $0.0037 at 1,347 won per USDT (our arithmetic), and traded about 1.6% above Binance at 08:48 UTC.
Hyperliquid lists RSR with 3x max leverage and -0.1254% hourly funding.
OKX code nexu888 returns 40% of fees hourly; Hyperliquid code NEXU888; Bybit code 48553.

seo.description: Reserve Rights (RSR) rose about 46% on 12 October 2026 after Upbit listed it against the Korean won; Binance funding hit -1.96% and open interest grew 4.4x in eight hours.

aeo.directAnswer: RSR rose about 46% in 24 hours on 12 October 2026 because Upbit announced at 04:54 UTC that it would list Reserve Rights against the Korean won and USDT, with trading from 05:05 UTC. Binance spot peaked at $0.002999 and was near $0.00236 at 08:48 UTC; Binance perpetual funding settled at -1.96% (floor -2%) and OKX at its -1% floor, so shorts are paying longs heavily.
